lore:
The true origins of Wanda remain a subject of widespread debate among the people of Cambrian.

Some claim to have seen Wanda fall onto the lakeshore while seated upon a massive boulder.

One man insists that she was once a pharaoh from Remouahe. He claims to have seen the same spinal needles embedded in a mummy.

Others say she was a duchess from the Franco Highlands who inherited a vast fortune after all four of her husbands died in succession.

...

The rumors scattered like leaves in the wind, while the villagers continued to farm, weave, and grind.

In those harsh years, heavy taxes hung over them like a razor, cutting away every budding hope and illusion.

Yet whenever they passed the lake where the queen resided, music from the thicket easily captivated their hearts.

It was a melody that had no place in that land—too beautiful, too languid. It seemed almost wicked, like a devil's whisper.

"Come. Cast all of this aside."

"The merciful queen sits at the center of the lake, waiting to receive the service of her blind servants..."

So, on a windless night, the weary villagers put down their tools and decided to satisfy their curiosity.

They skirted the forest and crossed a small bridge. Flowers bloomed along the path, but they spared them not a glance.

Before them lay a green lake connected to the low-hanging, star-filled sky. An ancient castle rose along its edge.

The thorn-crowned queen sat at the center of the lake, patiently awaiting the pilgrims.

She extended her hand and reveled in the kisses and worship of mere mortals.

The dark clouds parted, and the bright moon emerged.

The queen drove a spinal needle into the villager's back.

Paralyzing liquid spread through his veins. He fell to his knees as his limbs were dismembered and his eyes gouged out.

At that moment, the earth's heavy gravity could no longer hold him. All his poetry and dreams were tethered solely to the queen.

At last, he welcomed his destiny.
